verdict.summary: The shared helper correctly makes label-filtered open-issue listing the primary lookup, preserves the legacy search only as a migration/truncation supplement, distinguishes an unavailable probe from a confirmed miss, and keeps the coverage caller read-only. The three filers now create and apply their load-bearing labels before dedupe, while bench triage uses its existing labels. The hermetic test exercises every real call site, the lagging-index regression, fallback/backfill behavior, failure semantics, and CI wiring; all 23 tests pass. No correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defects were found in the diff.
